transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I’m here because flying has started to feel way scarier than it really should. Just the idea of getting on a plane makes me picture that turbulence from my honeymoon flight all over again. I mean, I know people fly safely every single day, but I just can't seem to shake it, and it's starting to bother me.
Is this intense anxiety limited only to flying, or do you experience similar feelings in other situations, such as on other public transportation or in crowded places?
No, it's really just flying. I don't have any issues with buses or trains, or, you know, being in crowded places. It's literally just airplanes. Everything else is completely fine.
Do you ever have nightmares about that flight?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I don't wake up having nightmares about it or anything like that. It's really just when I'm awake and, you know, actually thinking about having to get on a plane. But my sleep is completely fine.
